title: Tungkhungia Buranji: The Primary Assamese Royal Chronicle (1681–1826 A.D.)
title_english: Tungkhungia Buranji: The Primary Assamese Royal Chronicle (1681–1826 A.D.)
title_as: টুংখুঙীয়া বুৰঞ্জী: প্ৰাথমিক সাঁচিপতীয়া অসমীয়া পাঠ
title_tai: ပိုၼ်းမိူင်း တူင်ႇၶမ် ၸဝ်ႈၾႃႉ ၵဝ်ႇ ဢႃႇႁူမ်ႇ လႄႈ လႅၼ်လိၼ် ၼေႃႇရႃႇ
author: Srinath Barbarua & Dr. Suryya Kumar Bhuyan (Ed.)
provenance: Department of Historical and Antiquarian Studies (DHAS), Assam, Gauhati; DLI Archive 2015.452450
description: The authoritative vernacular Assamese text of the Tungkhungia Buranji edited by Dr. S. K. Bhuyan from the original sanchi-bark manuscript preserved by Srinath Duara Barbarua, chronicling the reigns of King Gadadhar Singha, Rudra Singha, Siva Singha, and trans-Patkai diplomacy with the Nora and Shan rulers.
